name: Pickerel Lake Recreation Area (East Campground)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 200 m half-width (0.44 m/px) and a 110 m half-width frame (0.24 m/px) over the lake-side west rows, every Go Outdoors SD facID=47 loop 82 (East Campground) unit point plotted; both frames rendered. West rows facing Pickerel Lake: 49E ~20 m and 51E ~21 m, 48E ~38 m, 56E ~31 m, 57E ~35 m from the water's edge, all behind a continuous wooded shore belt (no open ground between any pad and the water); the east-side loop 59E-72E sits farther inland behind the west rows and woods. No RV pad has open ground to the water, so not lakefront; the nearest rows (48E-51E, 54E-58E) are a filtered view through the trees -> lakeview, by the same reading as Roy Lake's East Unit (5742). Natural glacial lake, no dam.
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=47 ('Pickerel Lake Recreation Area'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, loop 82 (the East Campground): 29 web-bookable electric RV sites 44E-72E, every one 'Back-In Campsite', 'Amp Service: 50', MaxEquipLength 55-85 ft, UnitBasePrice $30; camping cabins C5-C7 ($60); host V2 not sold online. GFP East Campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/pickerel_e_cg.pdf (ArcGIS Pro, 2025-03-17): the same numbering on the east shore, with restroom/shower, vault toilets, water hydrants, playground, dump station, fish cleaning station, boat ramp, boat wash, kayak launch, fishing pier and swim beach, and its own entrance booth and road from the east side (Hwy 6); 2026 booking-site reviews describe 'Pickeral Lake East Campground' and pad #70. Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel back-in pads at the unit points on two wooded loops. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 55 ft, 54E-56E). 2.43 km from the West Campground RV-site centroid to centroid (nearest sites 44E and 13E, 2.21 km), across the lake with its own entrance. Not in the DB before (split from 5751 Pickerel Lake Recreation Area, 2026-11-22). Public (state): no price gate.
note: Pickerel Lake Recreation Area's East Campground, on the wooded east shore of Pickerel Lake N of Waubay, with its own entrance, boat ramp, fishing pier, fish-cleaning station, swim beach and camping cabins. The West Campground, about 2.4 km away on the north shore, is a separate entry. Shore-side sites 48E-58E look at the lake through the trees. 2026 reviews on the booking site warn of branches overhanging the roads that can scrape rooftop units. --Claude

season.note: October 1 to April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be off; vault toilets stay open.

fees.note: GFP publishes this park's own rate: electric $30 a night (the statewide $7 electrical fee is already in the electric figure). Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.
